issue: Field/placeholder mapping not enforced at submission
actual: Submitted a custom template with content containing placeholders {{customerName}} and {{orderId}} but only defined a mismatched field 'wrongField'; submission succeeded (no validation error) and the resulting generated preview showed unresolved placeholders verbatim: 'Hello {{customerName}}, your order {{orderId}} has shipped.'

evidence: Clicking Submit Template with all fields blank kept the dialog open (no submission); clicking submit again with title/author/description/content filled but zero defined fields also kept the dialog open, blocking submission until content was adjusted

issue: Duplicate field labels not rejected or disambiguated
actual: Adding a second field labeled 'clientName' (duplicate of an existing field) was silently accepted; the field-definition list in the submit dialog only showed 2 fields (deduplicated view), but after submission the template's fill form actually rendered 3 inputs: 'clientName *' (required), 'startDate', and a second unlabeled-asterisk 'clientName' input, both sharing colliding data-semtag-id 'preview.fields.item.clientname' and triggering additional console errors (React duplicate key warnings)

After navigating/reloading http://localhost:6089/, favorites count remained '1' with Professional Resume still favorited (state 'on'), and all 4 custom templates (QA Custom Template, Project Kickoff Note, Simple Greeting Note, Lowercase Key Test) persisted in the grid, total still 10 of 10 templates
